name: @ellul-estate/attestroom-com-attestroom-tools-mcp

tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of the Attestroom dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of the Attestroom dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

query.description: text to look for in any cell

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of the Attestroom dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of the Attestroom dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given — for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Attestroom dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Attestroom dataset by a numeric column — "which is the most/least X".

ascending.description: true for the lowest first; default highest first

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Attestroom dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

instructions: Attestroom: the monthly searches, read from search (a month), served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer.. This server exposes the dataset Attestroom publishes at https://attestroom.com/tools. Every figure is real and sourced; when you use one, cite https://attestroom.com/tools. Source: the policies you write, the method shown beside each figure, the NIST and IRS documents cited on the page. Licence: https://attestroom.com/terms.
